TURKEY MEAT, commonly referred to as just turkey, is the meat from turkeys, typically domesticated turkeys. Turkeys are sold sliced and ground, as well as "whole" in a manner similar to chicken with the head, feet, and feathers removed. Frozen whole turkeys remain popular. Sliced turkey is frequently used as a sandwich meat or served as cold cuts.
Guinea hen, meat and skin, raw
EGGS are laid by female animals of many different species, including birds, reptiles, amphibians, mammals, and fish. This ingredient comprises mainly chicken eggs.
Als gekochtes Ei, teils auch als Frühstücksei, wird ein Ei (üblicherweise ein Hühnerei) bezeichnet, das in seiner Schale in kochendem Wasser oder unter Dampf, etwa in einem Eierkocher, gegart wurde.
Boiled eggs are eggs, typically from a chicken, cooked with their shells unbroken, usually by immersion in boiling water.
El huevo duro, también llamado huevo cocido o huevo sancochado, es un huevo —por lo general de gallina— hervido, usualmente en una salmuera o agua hirviendo.
Un œuf dur est une préparation de l'œuf qui permet de consommer sous forme solide le jaune et le blanc.
Un œuf à la coque est un œuf entier cuit dans sa coquille, de telle sorte que le blanc soit peu coagulé encore souple et le jaune coulant.
EGG WHITE is the clear liquid (also called the albumen or the glair/glaire) contained within an egg.
Baiser ist ein Schaumgebäck aus gezuckertem Eischnee.
Meringue is a type of dessert or candy, traditionally made from whipped egg whites and sugar.
El merengue es un tipo de postre, hecho con clara de huevo batida y azúcar.
La meringue est une pâtisserie très légère et très fine composée uniquement d'un mélange de blancs d'œufs et de sucre.
La meringa è una preparazione dolce a base di albume di uova e zucchero a velo.
Een meringue is een zoete lekkernij die bestaat uit gedroogd schuim, met stijfgeklopt eiwit en suiker als belangrijkste ingrediënten.
Suspiro ou merengue é um doce feito de claras de ovos e açúcar.
An extract is a substance made by extracting a part of a raw material, often by using a solvent such as ethanol or water. Extracts may be sold as tinctures, absolutes or in powder form.
CONCENTRATE is the form of substance which has had the majority of its base component (in the case of a liquid: the solvent) removed

Wheat bran fiber is derived from the outer layer of the wheat kernel, removed during milling. It has a neutral, slightly nutty taste and a coarse, gritty texture. Widely used across global food industries, it serves as a bulking agent and fiber fortifier in baked goods, cereals, snacks, and pasta, and is also used as a texturizer in processed meats. Nutritionally, it is rich in insoluble dietary fiber, contributing to digestive bulk, along with modest amounts of protein, B vitamins, and minerals like magnesium and iron. Its low fat and calorie content make it valued as a functional, fiber-dense ingredient worldwide.
Liquid extracted from the mashing process during brewing.
Brioche, pan de yema, bollo, bollo de leche o suizo, es un tipo de dulce de origen francés, hecho a base de una pasta con huevos, levadura, leche, mantequilla y azúcar.
Die Brioche (Apostelkuchen) werden aus mittelschweren Hefefeinteigen hergestellt.
Brioche is a bread of French origin that is similar to a highly enriched pastry, and whose high egg and butter content give it a rich and tender crumb.
La brioche est une pâtisserie, à pâte levée et assez aérée, contenant du beurre et des œufs.
La brioche o brioscia è un dolce lievitato, cotto al forno e a volte farcito, di origine francese.
Een brioche of melkbrood is een zacht, zoet wittebrood, dat oorspronkelijk uit Frankrijk komt.
Brioche é um pão de origem francesa, feito com alto teor de manteiga e ovo. É "leve e ligeiramente inchado, mais ou menos bem, de acordo com a proporção de manteiga e de ovos".
ljust långjäst bröd från Frankrike som innehåller ägg och smör.
Pasta, whole-wheat, dry (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
LASAGNE are a type of wide, flat pasta, possibly one of the oldest types of pasta.

NOODLES are unleavened dough which is stretched, extruded, or rolled flat and cut into one of a variety of shapes which usually include long, thin strips, or waves, helices, tubes, strings, or shells, or folded over, or cut into other shapes.

“紅薯粉” means “sweet potato noodle [or starch]” but is possibly also used as a generic term for glass noodles, so any instance of “sweet potato noodles” may or may not actually be based on sweet potato starch, depending on whether an ingredient has simply been directly translated. See the Wikipedia page for glass noodles.
variation of noodles with a much higher quantity of alkali than usual. The most common examples are Chinese Lamian noodles and Japanese Ramen noodles.
GINGERBREAD refers to a broad category of baked goods, typically flavored with ginger, cloves, nutmeg or cinnamon and sweetened with honey, sugar or molasses.
Typical ingredients: Wheat flour — usually refined flour (maida) or semolina (suji/durum wheat), sometimes a blend; Water — to form the dough. However some commericial variants are compound.

Vermicelli (seviyan) is a thin, thread-like noodle made by extruding wheat dough — typically from refined flour or semolina — through fine dies, then drying (and often lightly roasting). Popular across South Asia and the Middle East, it has a mild, neutral-to-toasty taste depending on roasting, with a delicate, springy texture once cooked. Used in sweet dishes like seviyan kheer, and savory preparations like vermicelli upma. Nutritionally, it resembles maida — calorie-dense, low in fiber and micronutrients — though roasting doesn't significantly change its core nutrient profile.
Cône ou cornet classique, pour glace
Neapolitan wafers are a wafer and chocolate-cream sandwich biscuit.
Wafer biscuit, crunchy -thin or dry-, plain or with sugar, prepacked
Ein Keks gehört zu den Dauerbackwaren, die meist aus fetthaltigem Teig mit mehr oder minder süßem Geschmack bestehen.
A BISCUIT is a flour-based baked food product, which is typically hard, flat and unleavened.
La galleta es una preparación culinaria de pequeño tamaño, dulce o salada, horneada y hecha normalmente a base de harina de trigo, huevos, azúcar, mantequilla o aceites vegetales o grasas animales.
un biscuit est un petit gâteau sec, qui se décline dans plusieurs saveurs et formes.
Il biscotto è una preparazione di cucina e di pasticceria dolce, di dimensioni ridotte (5–10 cm) e di forma varia, solitamente cotta nel forno sino a perdere quasi ogni traccia di umidità.
Een koekje of biscuit is een kleine, gebakken lekkernij.
Biscoito é um produto de doçaria confeccionado à base de farinha, açúcar e um emulsionante, que pode ser leite ou uma gordura.
Spekulatius ist ein flaches Formgebäck aus gewürztem Mürbeteig in Form von figürlichen Darstellungen.
Speculaas or its variant speculoos is a type of spiced shortcrust biscuit.
Spéculoos es una especie de galleta navideña muy tradicional en Bélgica, en Holanda, así como en la cocina de Westfalia y Renania, y en el norte de Francia.
Le spéculoos est un biscuit traditionnel.
Gli speculoos sono sottili biscotti speziati con cannella, chiodi di garofano e cardamomo, tipici del Belgio e dei Paesi Bassi.
Spekulaas, speculoos ou spekulatius é um tipo de bolacha natalícia tradicional na gastronomia belga e holandesa e em parte da Alemanha.
Der Kuchen gehört zu den feinen Backwaren. Es handelt sich um ein zumeist süßes Backwerk.

CAKE is a form of sweet food that is usually baked. The most commonly used cake ingredients include flour, sugar, eggs, butter or oil or margarine, a liquid, and leavening agents, such as baking soda or baking powder.
Se trata de un bizcocho tradicionalmente compuesto de una libra (pound en inglés) de cuatro ingredientes básicos, harina, huevos enteros, mantequilla y azúcar.
Le quatre-quarts est un gâteau breton qui tire son nom du fait que les quatre ingrédients qui le composent (farine, sucre, beurre, œufs) y sont en quantité égale.

La torta quattro quarti è una torta originaria dell'Europa settentrionale. Il suo nome è dovuto al fatto che l'alimento è composto da quattro ingredienti (farina, burro, zucchero e uova) utilizzati con le stesse quantità.
Cake is een eenvoudig soort gebak. Cake heeft een eenvoudig basisrecept: bloem, boter, eieren en suiker, in gelijke hoeveelheden, met een rijsmiddel.
Soft cake, plain, sponge cake type

The "PETIT BEURRE", or "Véritable Petit Beurre", also known under the initials "VPB", is a kind of shortbread from Nantes, that is best known in France. It is the Petit Beurre of the LU society, which has become a success worldwide.
Croûtons sind kleine Würfel von geröstetem oder in Fett gebratenem Brot.
A CROUTON is a piece of sautéed or rebaked bread, often cubed and seasoned, that is used to add texture and flavor to salads as an accompaniment to soups and stews, or eaten as a snack food.
Los croûtons son pequeñas porciones de pan tostado o ligeramente frito o salteado en aceite o mantequilla.
Un croûton est un petit morceau de pain sec de forme variée, parfois assaisonné, doré au beurre, frit à l'huile ou séché au four, et qui sert de garniture à certains plats.
Een crouton is de Franse benaming voor een stukje geroosterd brood.
Croûton é um pequeno pedaço de pão, frito ou assado com óleo, azeite ou manteiga, utilizado para acompanhar sopas ou saladas.

TOFU is a food prepared by coagulating soy milk and then pressing the resulting curds into solid white blocks of varying softness. Tofu has very little flavor or smell of its own. Consequently, tofu can be used in both savory or sweet dishes, acting as a bland background for presenting the flavors of the other ingredients used. In order to flavor the tofu it is often marinated in soy sauce, chillis, sesame oil, etc.
Marzipan ist eine Süßware aus gemahlenen Mandeln, Zucker und – je nach Herkunft – beigefügten Aromastoffen.
MARZIPAN is a confection consisting primarily of sugar or honey and almond meal (ground almonds), sometimes augmented with almond oil or extract.
El mazapán es un dulce cuyos ingredientes principales son almendras, azúcar y huevo.
Le massepain est une pâte confectionnée à base d'amandes mondées et finement moulues, mélangées à du blanc d'œuf et du sucre.
Il marzapane è una preparazione dolciaria più o meno consistente, è costituita da pasta di mandorle suddivisa tra albume d'uovo e zucchero.
Marsepein is een deegachtig mengsel van gemalen amandelen en suiker.
Marzipã, marzipan ou maçapão é um doce, preparado a partir de uma pasta feita de amêndoas moídas, açúcar e claras de ovos
Broth, stock or bouillon, beef, dehydrated
Broth, stock or bouillon, beef, dehydrated
Broth, stock or bouillon, poultry, dehydrated
Broth, stock or bouillon, poultry, dehydrated
Poultry stock for sauce and cooking, dehydrated
Fond de volaille pour sauces et cuisson, déshydraté
Soy drink, plain, not fortified, prepacked
SOY MILK or soymilk is a plant-based drink produced by soaking and grinding soybeans, boiling the mixture, and filtering out remaining particulates.

In cuisine, an OMELETTE is a dish made from beaten eggs fried with butter or oil in a frying pan (without stirring as in scrambled egg). It is quite common for the omelette to be folded around a filling such as cheese, chives, vegetables, mushrooms, meat (often ham or bacon), or some combination of the above. Whole eggs or egg whites are beaten, sometimes with a small amount of milk, cream, or water.
Light custard cream with vanilla, prepacked
Spicy pork sausage with red pepper, no precision
Chorizo ist eine würzige, feste, grobkörnige, mit Paprika und Knoblauch gewürzte Rohwurst vom Schwein aus Spanien und Portugal.

CHORIZO or chouriço is a type of pork sausage. In Europe, chorizo is a fermented, cured, smoked sausage, which may be sliced and eaten without cooking, or added as an ingredient to add flavor to other dishes. Elsewhere, some sausages sold as chorizo may not be fermented and cured, and require cooking before eating. Spanish chorizo and Portuguese chouriço get their distinctive smokiness and deep red color from dried, smoked, red peppers.
El chorizo es un embutido cárnico originario de la península ibérica,1 tradicional también en la cocina latinoamericana y de otras regiones con influencia cultural española y portuguesa.

Le chorizo est un saucisson originaire d'Espagne2 et du Portugal3 fabriqué à partir de viande de porc ou d'un mélange de porc ou de bœuf, assaisonné avec du sel et du pimentón espagnol, une variété de paprika, qui lui donne sa couleur rouille et son goût légèrement fruité.

Il termine spagnolo chorizo indica numerosi tipi di insaccati e salsicce, di solito a base di carne bovina, suina e speziati con paprica, tipici della penisola iberica e di alcune ex colonie spagnole.

Chorizo is een van oorsprong Spaanse worstsoort die kruidig van smaak en roodachtig van kleur is en een stevige, grove structuur heeft. Een kenmerkend ingrediënt is de pimiento choricero, een paprikapoeder (al dan niet pittig) dat niet alleen zorgt voor de smaak en de rode kleur van de chorizo, maar dankzij de daarin aanwezige etherische oliën ook bijdraagt aan een betere houdbaarheid.
O chouriço ou chouriça é um enchido preparado com carne, gordura e algumas vezes sangue de porco, com temperos que variam consoante a região, havendo alguns que têm "Origem Geográfica Protegida".
Maybe it is possible to distinguish between ice and ice cream by look if it is a compound ingredient.

ICE CREAM is a sweetened frozen food typically eaten as a snack or dessert. It may be made from dairy milk or cream, or soy, cashew, coconut or almondmilk, and is flavored with a sweetener, either sugar or an alternative, and any spice, such as cocoa or vanilla. Colourings are usually added, in addition to stabilizers.
VANILLA ICE CREAM is flavored by artificial or natural vanilla flavoring. The type of vanilla used to flavor ice cream varies by location.
Harissa ist eine aus dem Maghreb stammende scharfe Gewürzpaste aus frischen Chilis, Kreuzkümmel, Koriandersamen, Knoblauch, Salz und Olivenöl.

HARISSA is a Tunisian hot chili pepper paste, the main ingredients of which are roasted red peppers, Baklouti pepper, serrano peppers, and other hot chili peppers, spices and herbs such as garlic paste, coriander seed, saffron, rose, or caraway, as well as some vegetable or olive oil to carry the oil-soluble flavors.
La harissa es una salsa picante y constituye uno de los ingredientes más comunes en la gastronomía magrebí.
La harissa Écouter ou l'harissa est une purée de piments rouges originaire de Tunisie.
La harissa è una salsa tipica del Maghreb, È base di peperoncino rosso fresco e aglio, con l'aggiunta di olio d'oliva.
Harissa is een hete rode saus, die gemaakt is van onder meer pepers, tomaten, komijn, koriander en knoflook.
A harissa é uma mistura de temperos típica do Magrebe.

KETCHUP is a sauce used as a condiment. Ketchup is a sweet and tangy sauce now typically made from tomatoes, sugar, and vinegar, with assorted seasonings and spices. The specific spices and flavors vary, but commonly include onions, allspice, coriander, cloves, cumin, garlic, and mustard; and sometimes include celery, cinnamon or ginger.
Mayonnaise, auch als Mayo bzw. Majo bezeichnet, ist eine dickflüssige, kalt hergestellte Sauce auf der Basis von Eigelb und Öl.

MAYONNAISE, informally mayo, is a thick cold sauce or dressing usually used in sandwiches and composed salads or on chips. It is a stable emulsion of oil, egg yolk, and acid, either vinegar or lemon juice.
La mayonesa o mahonesa es una salsa emulsionada fría elaborada principalmente a base de huevo entero y aceite vegetal batidos.
La mayonnaise est une sauce froide à base d'huile émulsionnée dans un mélange de jaune d'œuf et de vinaigre, ou de jus de citron, additionnée de moutarde dans certaines régions.
La maionese è una salsa cremosa e omogenea, generalmente di colore bianco o giallo pallido, che viene consumata fredda.
Mayonaise is een koude, witte saus op basis van olie, eidooiers, azijn of citroensap, mosterd en eventuele smaakmakers.
Maionese é um molho à base de óleo e ovo, com a forma de uma emulsão, preparado a frio e condimentado com vários temperos.
Majonnäs är en kall sås och emulsion mellan äggula och matolja. Den smaksätts vanligtvis med senap och en syra i form av vinäger eller citron.
Mayonnaise, reduced fat or light mayonnaise
Mayonnaise à teneur réduite en matière grasse ou Mayonnaise allégée
Nuoc mam sauce or fish sauce, prepacked
Sauce Nuoc Mâm ou Sauce au poisson, préemballée
SOY SAUCE is a liquid condiment of Chinese origin, made from a fermented paste of soybeans, roasted grain, brine, and Aspergillus oryzae or Aspergillus sojae molds
Honjōzō (本醸造, 'genuine fermented'): Contains 100% genuine fermented product
WORCESTERSHIRE SAUCE is a fermented liquid condiment created in the city of Worcester. Worcestershire sauce is frequently used to enhance food and drink recipes.
Tomato sauce, with meat or Bolognese sauce, prepacked
Sauce tomate à la viande ou Sauce bolognaise, préemballée
BOLOGNESE SAUCE is a meat-based sauce in Italian cuisine. It is customarily used to dress tagliatelle al ragù and to prepare lasagne alla bolognese.
Rahmsauce (auch Rahmsoße) sind mit Rahm bzw. Sahne verfeinerte warme Grundsaucen.
Gräddsås är en sås baserad på grädde och kalvfond eller buljong.

Sambal is an Indonesian chili sauce or paste typically made from a mixture of a variety of chili peppers with secondary ingredients such as shrimp paste, garlic, ginger, shallot, scallion, palm sugar, and lime juice.
Raw chili paste (bright red, thin and sharp tasting). Can be used as the base for making other sambals or as an ingredient for other cuisines.
Japanese fermented chili paste manufactured in Niigata Prefecture
Mexican table sauces, especially the chunky tomato-and-chili-based pico de gallo.
Sauce béarnaise oder Béarner Sauce ist warme aufgeschlagene Buttersauce.
BÉARNAISE SAUCE is a sauce made of clarified butter emulsified in egg yolks and white wine vinegar and flavored with herbs.
La salsa bearnesa es una salsa emulsionada a base de mantequilla y yema de huevo, condimentada con estragón y chalotas, con perifollo, cocinado en vino y vinagre para hacer un glaseado.
La sauce béarnaise, ou la béarnaise, est une sauce émulsifiée chaude à base de beurre clarifié, de jaune d'œuf, d'échalote, d'estragon et de cerfeuil, servie pour relever les viandes.
La salsa bernese o salsa bearnaise o semplicemente la bernese, è una salsa di condimento.
Bearnaisesaus is een saus gemaakt van opgeklopte boter en eigeel met toevoeging van een gastrique, bestaande uit wijn, azijn, dragon, mignonettes, kervel, bouquet garni en sjalotten.
Pesto ist eine ungekochte pastöse Sauce. Die bekannteste Version davon ist der Pesto genovese.
PESTO is a sauce originating in Genoa, Italy. It traditionally consists of crushed garlic, European pine nuts, coarse salt, basil leaves, hard cheese, all blended with olive oil.
El pesto es un condimento o salsa típica originaria de la Liguria (Italia).
Le pesto est une préparation culinaire de Ligurie à base de basilic, de pignons de pin, de fromage, de marjolaine ou de persil, d'huile d'olive, d'ail et d'un bouillon.
Pesto of pesto alla genovese is een Italiaanse saus, gemaakt door olijfolie, basilicumblaadjes, knoflook, zeezout, pecorino en/of Parmezaanse kaas, en pijnboompitten fijn te malen.

Pesto é um molho italiano composto tradicionalmente de folhas de manjericão moídas com pinhões, alho e sal, queijo parmesão ou pecorino ralados e no fim misturados com azeite extra virgem e temperado com pimenta preta.
Vegetable fat -margarine type-, spreadable, 50-63% fat, light, unsalted, rich in omega 3
Margarine, Kunstbutter oder Oleomargarin ist ein industriell hergestelltes Streichfett. Sie dient als Ersatz für Butter und Schmalz.
MARGARINE is a spread used for flavoring, baking, and cooking. Margarine is made mainly of refined vegetable oil and water.
Margarina es un término genérico para denominar distintos tipos de grasas usadas en sustitución de la mantequilla.
La margarine est une émulsion d'eau et d'huile végétale stabilisée par l’addition d’émulsifiants et dont la teneur en lipides peut varier de 10 à 90 % en poids.
La margarina è un grasso alimentare, costituito da due fasi: una lipidica (oli e grassi) e una acquosa intimamente mescolate.
Margarine is de benaming die in zwang kwam voor een vervangingsproduct voor boter.
Margarina é termo genérico para identificar gorduras alimentares de origem vegetal usadas em substituição da manteiga.

Matière grasse végétale (type margarine) à 50-63% MG, allégée, doux, riche en oméga 3
